headline: Elevance Health Strengthens Connected Cancer Care Model to Support Consumers Through Their Health Journey
summary: INDIANAPOLIS, July 30, 2026--Cancer care is often overwhelming, not just medically, but emotionally and logistically. Elevance Health is strengthening its connected cancer care model to enhance support consumers receive throughout their care journeys, with a focus on earlier support, personalized care navigation, and more coordinated care.
